Each entry is a known, human-reviewed item -- either a scanner false positive or accepted/tracked technical debt -- NOT a blanket count baseline. Any finding whose fingerprint is not in this list fails the audit-baseline CI job (fix the code, or add a new reviewed entry here).

Never edit scripts/audit/performance_audit.py or security_audit.py to special-case a finding.
